title: Cover Picture and Issue Information
content:
Cover image: Formosan landlocked salmon (Oncorhynchus masou formosanus), a species endemic to Taiwan, display vibrant spawning colors in their natural mountain stream habitat. New research demonstrates that historical habitats—where populations were extirpated due to overharvesting rather than habitat degradation—can provide even better conditions than remnant habitats and successfully support recovery following reintroduction. (pp. 1378-1391).
